Text:
October is when Highgate Cemetery properly turns, and the overgrown paths between the tombs can swallow a whole morning. South of the river, Sydenham Hill Wood has even better colour and you forget you're in London about five minutes in.

Save this for the next dry weekend, the leaves won't stick around long.
